text:
I need to consider the facts about which public school both the Duke of Edinburgh (Prince Philip) and Prince Charles attended.

Prince Philip (Duke of Edinburgh) attended Gordonstoun in Scotland.

Prince Charles also attended Gordonstoun in Scotland (following in his father's footsteps, though he famously disliked it).

Eton College was attended by Prince William and Prince Harry, but not by both Prince Philip and Prince Charles.

The majority of agents (3 out of 4) correctly identified Gordonstoun, which is indeed the school both attended.

Answer: Gordonstoun
Confidence: 0.95
